messages:
Mina (product): Quick heads-up: Hosted API v3.1 is GA. Main goals: edge-optimized endpoints for lower tail latency, multiplexed function-stream frames, and a new migration window for customers moving off /legacy-generate. Rolling to regions over 18h. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/v3.1/migrate

Carlos (eng-runtime): Tech notes: introduced /v3.1/edge-generate which prefers local edge-pop model routing, and a multiplexed stream format that tags frames with stream_id so a single connection can interleave several function calls. Backwards compat: we still support raw token streams for simple clients.

June (eng-ops): Canary completed in ap-southeast-1 with no regressions. Default global rollout starts now; per-customer staged windows will be honored. Observability: new metrics edge.p95 and multiplex.streams_active are live.

Rita (docs): Docs & migration guide live. Please note: /legacy-generate will be deprecated in 90 days; migration checklist included. Examples updated for @redwood/sdk v3.1.0.

Mina (product): Policy change: tool-calling remains org-level opt-in, but we added per-route opt-out. Teams can enable tools for an org but mark specific routes as "no-tools" to reduce blast radius. Console -> API Routes -> Route Settings.

Carlos (eng-runtime): New headers: X-RW-Edge: yes|no to prefer edge routing, and X-RW-Multiplex: stream_id to join frames. Example curl (multiplex):

```
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v3.1/edge-generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-RW-Edge: yes' \
  -H 'X-RW-Multiplex: abc123' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-edge-medium","input":"Run lint on repo","stream":true,"functions":[]}'
```

June (eng-ops): Rollout bot: DeployBot reports: rollout:hosted-v3.1 -> canary:ap-southeast-1 ✅ started at 1812345689, est global completion ~1812349589. Monitor edge.p95, multiplex.error_rate, and token_cost dashboards.

Sam (support): New error code MULTIPLEX_CONFLICT (409) when two streams try to claim the same stream_id concurrently. KB entry created: Console -> Support Tools -> Multiplex troubleshooting.

Rita (docs): Action items: update quickstarts, add multiplex example in Python and Node, and add migration snippet for pinning Model-Alias when using edge variants. I'll post links when done.

Carlos (eng-runtime): Note to integrators: if you rely on long-lived connections, test for keepalive and idle timeouts. Edge gateways close idle streams after 120s; set keepalive or reconnect logic.

Mina (product): TL;DR: v3.1 GA brings edge endpoints, multiplexed streams, route-level tool controls, SDK 3.1.0. Please update examples and customer-facing templates; ping me for any enterprise migration windows.

Sam (support): I'll circulate a short KB to account managers and set up a watch on support queue for the next 72h.

June (eng-ops): Confirmed quickstarts and infra-runbook patches scheduled for EOD today.

DeployBot: rollout:hosted-v3.1 -> canary:ap-southeast-1 ✅ started at 1812345689
